original_strict.scope: Complete native STA only; physical routing/PG/geometry/RC coverage and exact final-netlist functionality remain independently required

timed_endpoints.scope: Complete native STA only; physical routing/PG/geometry/RC coverage and exact final-netlist functionality remain independently required

timing.scope: Diagnostic endpoint typing; no physical load removal or waiver of any data endpoint/electrical/clock/count gate

rc_coverage.scope: Every native unannotated driver resolved with flat fanout through all arcs; separate connected-clock control is required

used_drivers.scope: Actual ODB input/output directions on used non-PG nets; floating connected nets are failures

pin_contract.scope: Expected rectangles derive only from complete receipt-bound placement script and its original JSON; exact native DBU comparison, no tolerance and no fitting to ODB observations.

software_controls.scope: Software comparator controls on original native-export TSV, bound to source and receiver receipts. No ODB editing, new STA/DRC qualification, or tolerance; fresh complete physical reception still required.

content.scope: Actual final ODB/SDC/SPEF independent full endpoint/electrical/PG/connectivity/pin/RC reception; function/full-deck/strict LEC separate
